claim: For every natural r and every pair of natural exponents i,j, the coefficient of t^i a^j in the exact Fill--Janson polynomial h(t,a;r) is nonnegative.
covered: Every natural r, including 0; not a finite experiment.
Every finitely supported exponent vector on Fin 2, which means every pair of coefficient indices.
Nonnegative coefficient closure under addition, multiplication, and powers.
All initial values and every successor recurrence are ring identities.
sourcePolynomial is written exactly as source (E.16), with t=X 0 and a=X 1.
source_bridge proves equality with the homogeneous expression after substitution.
scope_limits: This resolves the integer-exponent coefficient question in full. It does not formalize the separate real-exponent probability or root conjectures in the source paper.
